prepare.name: validate the committed release on OpenClaw
argv: set -euo pipefail; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; pnpm format:check; pnpm build; pnpm typecheck; pnpm lint; NODE_ENV=test pnpm test; pnpm --filter @creepjs/sdk check:size; bash scripts/secret-scan.sh; npx -y @fission-ai/openspec@latest validate --all --strict --no-interactive; pnpm --filter @creepjs/api exec wrangler deploy --dry-run; pnpm audit --audit-level=high

deploy.name: publish the exact commit through protected GitHub Actions

verify.name: browser acceptance on the canonical production site
